title: ImageDescriptionExtractorLLMOutput
description: LLM output schema for ImageExtractor description generation

description.description: Natural language description of the image (2-5 sentences)

structural_description.description: Mermaid diagram for structural images, typed as classDiagram, requirementDiagram, architecture-beta, or flowchart (empty string for non-structural)

has_structural_content.description: True if the image states the structure of a product or domain (parts, containment, relations); false for a process, sequence, state machine, chart, screenshot or photo
